applies_why: The judge text does not use a single verse's failure to state a link or its contrary as the ground for UNDERDETERMINED; it cites the defender's recorded dropping of the curse limb.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
why: The stated ground is the recorded dropping of the curse limb, not single-verse silence, so K-S2 is not breached.
